observations.behavior: Adds fan-out parent configuration and parent-child key mapping for Gusto warehouse ingestion, replacing the previous per-employee fan-out model.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to correctly identify parent-child relationships when Gusto returns nested employee data, preventing duplicate or orphaned records.

observations.behavior: Adds a dictionary mapping parent endpoint names to the child row key that carries the parent UUID, and removes the boolean fan-out flag.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a lookup table to construct the correct parent-child key for warehouse tables, supporting the fan-out parent configuration.

observations.behavior: Adds a new endpoint configuration for employee benefits with a fan-out parent and an extra parameter to include all benefits.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds ingestion of employee benefits, including all benefits regardless of default status, while correctly associating them with their parent company benefit.
